generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Interpret the validated task contract, select an appropriate planning pattern, and split the goal into bounded work units with explicit objectives, inputs, outputs and completion conditions. Also generate the planning plan text artifact for RSI.

contract.purpose_user_function: Interpret a validated task contract and decompose it into bounded work units with explicit IO and completion conditions.
contract.valid_inputs: Validated task/requirement contract, planning pattern/lane, context, capabilities, constraints, and evidence requirements.
contract.expected_outputs: Plan text/design/trace artifacts and bounded logical work units or a blocked planning result.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Invalid contract, missing required context/capability, unbounded work, incomplete acceptance, or infeasible decomposition blocks/returns errors.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Generic and AutoSci planner artifact generation is shipped; decomposition quality remains template/domain dependent.
contract.success_evidence: Every work unit traces to contract requirements and has explicit inputs, outputs, completion evidence, and bounded scope.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: minimal contract; multi-step; independent branches; missing acceptance; capability gap; plan text artifact; traceability.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/compiled_sprint_planner.py: generate_planner_artifacts(); harness/lib/apo_plan_compiler.py: build_capsule_plan_ir(), compile_execution_plan_for_node(); harness/lib/plan_validator.py: validate_plan(), compile_planner_graph()
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/compiled_sprint_planner.py: build_design_markdown(), build_plan_markdown(), generate_planner_artifacts(); harness/lib/autosci_intake_contract.py: build_autosci_task_graph()
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Compilation and validation are local; feasibility of chosen operators/tools depends on current registries, host health, provider access, policy, and workspace state.

implementation.entrypoints: harness/lib/compiled_sprint_planner.py: build_design_markdown(), build_plan_markdown(), generate_planner_artifacts(); harness/lib/autosci_intake_contract.py: build_autosci_task_graph()
